route.name: Meditation Apps Without a Subscription
route.description: Alternatives for selecting and playing personal adult guided meditations without mandatory recurring software payment. Reviewed public editions only; accounts and service limits apply. Calm also has limited free access. No clinical, offline or full-catalog equivalence.

products.name: Healthy Minds Program

products.name: Medito
products.short_description: Free guided meditations, breathing exercises, sleep content, and a timer.

products.name: Smiling Mind
products.short_description: Meditations and mental-fitness learning pathways for adults and children.

product_anchors.scope_description: For personal adult guided meditation, Smiling Mind lets you select an adult session and play guided audio, as observed with Exploring the Breath. This substitutes for the corresponding Calm selection/playback activity, without implying parity with Calm sleep stories, music or its entire catalog.

For personal adult guided meditation, Medito lets you choose a session from its courses and play guided audio, as observed with Learning to sit. This substitutes for selecting and playing a Calm guided meditation; it does not establish equivalent catalog, sleep stories or health outcomes.

For personal adult guided meditation, the Healthy Minds public program lets you choose and play a guided practice, as observed with Intro To Sitting Meditation. This substitutes for Calm guided-session selection and playback within a structured learning program, not for every Calm content category.

H1 — Public program entirely free and donor funded; iOS/Android registration required. Separate paid courses/events do not define app entitlement.
H2 — EULA names free donor-funded Public Subscription and distinguishes institutional/Foundations access. Personal license is conditional/revocable; updates may alter features.
H3 — Public program has Awareness/Connection/Insight/Purpose modules; Foundations recommended, moving among modules allowed. Institutional/research configurations may differ.
H4 — Older help article describes preloading identical activity choices for offline use; not a modern full download manager guarantee.
H5 — Older article says English-only and store-available countries with South Korea exception; present owner-store availability requires recheck.
H6 — Older support lists iOS 14+ / most Android 10+. Current App Store lists iOS 13.4+: preserve mismatch, do not choose a universal minimum.
H7 — Current US listing interface English, iOS 13.4+; account region/device not tested.
M1 — Guided meditation, courses and other content; no paywall, no required account or payment according to vendor.
M2 — AGPL applies to app code, not original audio. Original/partner content remains restricted; external reuse needs separate rights.
M3 — Developer listing documents session choice, playback and downloads; iOS 15+, English. Account-related release notes exist; no-account core does not mean no optional account features.
Owner Android guided meditation playback evidence — PR5.54
S1 — App is currently free; email account required; mobile/web access and adult guided activities documented. Statement excludes treatment purpose.
S2 — Adult meditation and learning pathways, content search/filtering, routines and progress; charity-supported free individual access.
S3 — Developer description includes offline downloads. Listing iOS 16.4+, interface English; this AU storefront is not owner-region installation proof.

taxonomy_anchors.name: Calm / Meditation
taxonomy_anchors.description: Meditation and sleep-content ecosystem; listing establishes software scope, not medical efficacy.

taxonomy_problems.name: Subscription Fatigue
taxonomy_problems.description: The user wants useful core functionality without another mandatory recurring subscription.

product_attributes.value_text: A broader mental-fitness app with adult, family and other sections; the comparison covers adult guided sessions only. Account registration is required. Download features are documented but offline playback was not tested.
iOS, Android, and Web browser access
Currently free individual access supported by the nonprofit; a registered account is required. This is not a perpetual-access guarantee.

A course-based meditation alternative rather than the complete Calm catalog. Core no-account access is vendor-documented but the owner tested signed in. App code licensing does not grant unrestricted reuse of original or partner audio.
Free public app and meditation content, supported by donations; no paid perpetual license is implied.

A structured Awareness, Connection, Insight and Purpose program rather than the complete Calm catalog. Registration is required. Older offline instructions and conflicting documented iOS requirements remain limitations; the Android sample does not resolve them.
Free donor-funded public access with registration; donations are optional. Separate paid courses, workplace or research agreements are outside this edition.

taxonomy_audiences.name: Meditation App Listeners
taxonomy_audiences.description: People comparing meditation or sleep-audio applications; no therapeutic outcome or medical suitability is asserted.

taxonomy_attributes.name: AI Optional
taxonomy_attributes.description: Core product workflows remain usable without enabling, purchasing, or depending on AI functionality. Integrated AI or optional AI plugins do not disqualify a product; evidence must support the non-AI core workflow.

taxonomy_attributes.name: Free Core Use
taxonomy_attributes.description: A meaningful core product workflow is available without a recurring software fee.

taxonomy_attributes.name: No Account Required
taxonomy_attributes.description: A meaningful local/core workflow can be started without creating a vendor account.

taxonomy_attributes.name: No Subscription
taxonomy_attributes.description: The named edition supports the stated meaningful core workflow without a mandatory recurring software payment. Free and perpetual paid editions may qualify; trials do not. Optional sync, AI, cloud, maintenance and paid upgrades must be disclosed.

taxonomy_attributes.name: Open Source
taxonomy_attributes.description: The product or its core editor is distributed under an open-source license according to current official materials.

taxonomy_attributes.name: Pricing Model
taxonomy_attributes.description: Source-backed pricing model and relevant edition scope; excludes transient numeric prices.

taxonomy_attributes.name: Supported Platforms
taxonomy_attributes.description: Source-listed platforms and edition scope; an omitted platform is not a verified negative.

taxonomy_attributes.name: Trade-Off Summary
taxonomy_attributes.description: Evidence-backed restrictions or explicitly provisional editorial interpretation, with confidence status.

taxonomy_attributes.name: Works Offline
taxonomy_attributes.description: Core work remains available without an internet connection.
